nodes.name: dialer
nodes.doc: dialer builds the WebSocket dialer; link.CAFile adds a private CA to the system roots for https:// hubs.

nodes.name: Main
nodes.doc: Main runs the CLI and returns the exit code.

nodes.name: buildStartConfig
nodes.doc: buildStartConfig builds the config of one command from the start flags.

nodes.name: call
nodes.doc: call sends one request to the daemon, spawning it when absent.

nodes.name: cmdStartup
nodes.doc: cmdStartup installs (install=true) or removes a systemd unit.

nodes.name: lastLines
nodes.doc: lastLines returns up to n trailing lines of a file and the offset after them.

nodes.name: listAfter
nodes.doc: listAfter prints the current table so users see state after a change.

nodes.name: newStartFlagSet
nodes.doc: newStartFlagSet declares the start flags and returns the values they fill.

nodes.name: parseInterspersed
nodes.doc: parseInterspersed lets flags appear before or after positional args.

nodes.name: resolveStartTargets
nodes.doc: resolveStartTargets turns the start target into the app configs to start: every app of an ecosystem file (filtered by --only) or one command.

nodes.name: CAPool
nodes.doc: CAPool returns the system roots plus the PEM certificates in file.

nodes.name: DefaultName
nodes.doc: DefaultName derives a process name from a script or command line.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.doc: Home returns the state directory: $PMGO_HOME or ~/.pm2go.

nodes.name: LoadEcosystem
nodes.doc: LoadEcosystem reads a JSON ecosystem file.

nodes.name: SafeName
nodes.doc: SafeName makes a process name usable as a file name.

nodes.name: DetachAttr
nodes.doc: DetachAttr starts the daemon detached from the console (CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | DETACHED_PROCESS).

nodes.name: Run
nodes.doc: Run starts the daemon and blocks until shutdown.

nodes.name: clearStaleSocket
nodes.doc: clearStaleSocket removes a unix socket file that nothing listens on.

nodes.name: gzipFile
nodes.doc: gzipFile compresses src into dst, then removes src.

nodes.name: readReady
nodes.doc: readReady closes ready when the pipe delivers a "ready" line.

nodes.name: Fingerprint
nodes.doc: Fingerprint reduces a line to a stable shape: timestamps, ids, numbers and quoted values are replaced so repeated occurrences group together.

nodes.name: FormatAlert
nodes.doc: FormatAlert builds the HTML message for a firing or resolved alert.

nodes.name: Home
nodes.doc: Home is $PMGO_HUB_HOME or ~/.pm2go-hub.

nodes.name: IsErrorLine
nodes.doc: IsErrorLine reports whether a line looks like an error.

nodes.name: LoadConfig
nodes.doc: LoadConfig reads the config, creating it with fresh secrets when absent.

nodes.name: Mode
nodes.doc: Mode names the serving mode for the startup log line.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.doc: Run starts the hub.

nodes.name: Warnings
nodes.doc: Warnings lists risky combinations to print at startup.

nodes.name: hsts
nodes.doc: hsts adds Strict-Transport-Security to every response.

nodes.name: loopbackAddr
nodes.doc: loopbackAddr reports whether a listen address only accepts local clients.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.doc: migrate applies every migration newer than the recorded version, each in its own transaction together with its schema_migrations row.

nodes.name: redirectToHTTPS
nodes.doc: redirectToHTTPS answers every request with a redirect to the same URL over HTTPS on the hub's TLS port.

nodes.name: Inherited
nodes.doc: Inherited returns the listener passed by pm2go.

nodes.name: Listener
nodes.doc: Listener is ListenerOn with a tcp fallback on ":$PORT", or ":8080" when PORT is not set.

nodes.name: ListenerOn
nodes.doc: ListenerOn returns the inherited listener, or net.Listen(network, addr) when the process is not under pm2go (or has no shared socket).

nodes.name: Ready
nodes.doc: Ready tells pm2go that the application is ready to serve.

nodes.name: Reload
nodes.doc: Reload re-reads link.json and (re)connects, or disconnects if it is gone.

nodes.name: exec
nodes.doc: exec runs one hub command against the local manager.

nodes.name: onEvent
nodes.doc: onEvent forwards a process event.

nodes.name: ListenSpec
nodes.doc: ListenSpec resolves the shared socket to a (network, address) pair.

nodes.name: UnmarshalJSON
nodes.doc: UnmarshalJSON also collects `env_<profile>` keys into EnvProfiles.

nodes.name: Flush
nodes.doc: Flush truncates the log files of the targets.

nodes.name: Reload
nodes.doc: Reload restarts processes one at a time per app name so multi-instance apps keep serving.

nodes.name: Resurrect
nodes.doc: Resurrect starts every app from the dump file that is not already known.

nodes.name: RunMonitor
nodes.doc: RunMonitor samples host and process usage until ctx ends, and enforces max_memory_restart.

nodes.name: Save
nodes.doc: Save writes every configured app to the dump file (one entry per name).

nodes.name: Scale
nodes.doc: Scale changes the instance count of an app without restarting existing ones.

nodes.name: SetHooks
nodes.doc: SetHooks registers receivers for process events and log lines.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.doc: Start adds an app, or updates the config of an existing one and restarts it.

nodes.name: StopAll
nodes.doc: StopAll stops every process; used on daemon shutdown.

nodes.name: System
nodes.doc: System returns the latest host sample.

nodes.name: byName
nodes.doc: byName returns all instances with the name, ordered by instance.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.doc: resolve returns the processes matching a target: "all", numeric id, name or namespace.

nodes.name: Reload
nodes.doc: Reload replaces the running child without a gap.

nodes.name: Running
nodes.doc: Running reports whether the supervise loop is active.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.doc: Start launches the supervise loop.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.doc: Stop signals the child, waits for the kill timeout, then kills the group.

nodes.name: buildCmd
nodes.doc: buildCmd prepares the child.

nodes.name: delay
nodes.doc: delay returns the wait before the next start.

nodes.name: emit
nodes.doc: emit reports a state change to the manager's event hook.

nodes.name: ensureLogs
nodes.doc: ensureLogs opens the log writers once; they stay open across restarts.

nodes.name: markReady
nodes.doc: markReady switches a launching child to online.

nodes.name: overlap
nodes.doc: overlap starts a replacement child next to the running one, waits until it is ready (or alive for min_uptime without wait_ready), then swaps and drains the old one with SIGTERM.

nodes.name: requestRestart
nodes.doc: requestRestart asks the loop for a restart that does not count as a crash.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.doc: spawn starts a new OS process for the proc.

nodes.name: supervise
nodes.doc: supervise blocks until the child exits, a soft restart or stop arrives, or the readiness window expires.

nodes.name: terminate
nodes.doc: terminate sends SIGTERM to the child's group and escalates to SIGKILL after the kill timeout.

nodes.name: wait
nodes.doc: wait sleeps for d.

nodes.name: watchLoop
nodes.doc: watchLoop polls the cwd and requests a soft restart on change.

nodes.name: Truncate
nodes.doc: Truncate empties the current file.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.doc: Write implements io.Writer.

nodes.name: acquire
nodes.doc: acquire returns the shared socket for the app, opening it on first use.

nodes.name: release
nodes.doc: release closes the shared socket of an app.

nodes.name: Active
nodes.doc: Active returns pending and firing alerts, most severe first.

nodes.name: Evaluate
nodes.doc: Evaluate runs one pass over all enabled rules.

nodes.name: History
nodes.doc: History returns recent alert transitions, newest first.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.doc: Run evaluates on a ticker until stop closes.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.doc: apply advances the state machine for one (rule, target).

nodes.name: dropStates
nodes.doc: dropStates forgets live state of a rule.

nodes.name: markSuppression
nodes.doc: markSuppression flags lower-level firing alerts covered by a higher one for the same target and type, then sends due notifications and reminders.

nodes.name: Flush
nodes.doc: Flush writes changed issues to the database.

nodes.name: List
nodes.doc: List returns issues, newest activity first.

nodes.name: Observe
nodes.doc: Observe records the line if it looks like an error.

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.doc: Notify queues a message to every chat whose min level allows it.

nodes.name: SendTest
nodes.doc: SendTest sends a message right away and returns the API error, if any.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.doc: Update stores new settings.

nodes.name: send
nodes.doc: send posts one message.

nodes.name: Attach
nodes.doc: Attach registers a connected agent after its hello.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.doc: Command sends a command to a connected agent and waits for its result.

nodes.name: CrashCount
nodes.doc: CrashCount counts unplanned exits of an app within the window.

nodes.name: LogsSince
nodes.doc: LogsSince returns lines newer than the time, used by log alert rules.

nodes.name: RecentLogs
nodes.doc: RecentLogs returns up to n lines of one app, oldest first.

nodes.name: States
nodes.doc: States returns a copy of every known server, marking stale ones offline.

nodes.name: Enabled
nodes.doc: Enabled reports whether the hub terminates TLS itself.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.doc: Validate rejects inconsistent flag combinations.

nodes.name: authed
nodes.doc: authed accepts a session cookie or "Authorization: Bearer <admin password>".

nodes.name: login
nodes.doc: login checks the password with a per-IP lockout that grows with failures.

nodes.name: GetCertificate
nodes.doc: GetCertificate is the tls.Config callback.

nodes.name: Reload
nodes.doc: Reload loads the files now.

nodes.name: last
nodes.doc: last returns up to n newest entries, oldest first.

nodes.name: since
nodes.doc: since returns entries newer than ts (unix ms).
pm2go is an internal process manager modelled on PM2.

nodes.name: agent
nodes.doc: Package agent connects the daemon to a hub: it streams snapshots, events and log lines out, and runs commands the hub sends back.

nodes.name: hub
nodes.doc: Package hub is the web dashboard server: it accepts agent connections, stores metrics and events, evaluates alert rules and notifies Telegram.

nodes.name: sdk/runtime
nodes.doc: Package runtime lets an application started by pm2go use the shared listening socket and the readiness protocol.

nodes.name: startOpts
nodes.doc: startOpts holds the parsed values of the start flags.

nodes.name: AppConfig
nodes.doc: AppConfig is one managed application.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.doc: Event is a process state change reported to the agent and hub.

nodes.name: LinkConfig
nodes.doc: LinkConfig tells the daemon's agent where the hub is.

nodes.name: LogLine
nodes.doc: LogLine is one line of child output.

nodes.name: ProcessInfo
nodes.doc: ProcessInfo is the daemon's view of one process, returned by list/describe.

nodes.name: StartParams
nodes.doc: StartParams starts (or updates and restarts) one app.

nodes.name: SystemSample
nodes.doc: SystemSample is the host-level view sent with every snapshot.

nodes.name: TargetParams
nodes.doc: TargetParams selects processes by numeric id, name, namespace or "all".

nodes.name: Manager
nodes.doc: Manager owns the process table.

nodes.name: Options
nodes.doc: Options tune daemon startup.

nodes.name: Proc
nodes.doc: Proc is one supervised process.

nodes.name: RotatingFile
nodes.doc: RotatingFile is an append-only log file that rotates by size.

nodes.name: child
nodes.doc: child is one running OS process of a Proc: the command, its exit channel and the readiness state.

nodes.name: listeners
nodes.doc: listeners is the registry of shared sockets, one per app name.

nodes.name: sharedListener
nodes.doc: sharedListener is a listening socket owned by the daemon.

nodes.name: superviseResult
nodes.doc: superviseResult tells loop how the current child ended.

nodes.name: AlertState
nodes.doc: AlertState is one tracked (rule, server, process) condition.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.doc: Config is stored in <home>/config.json.

nodes.name: Engine
nodes.doc: Engine evaluates rules against registry state on a timer.

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.doc: Issue groups similar error lines, like the PM2 Plus issues dashboard.

nodes.name: LogSub
nodes.doc: LogSub receives live log lines for one server/process.

nodes.name: Notifier
nodes.doc: Notifier sends alert messages through the Telegram Bot API.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.doc: Rule is one alert definition.

nodes.name: ServerState
nodes.doc: ServerState is the hub's view of one host.

nodes.name: Store
nodes.doc: Store wraps the SQLite database.

nodes.name: TLSOptions
nodes.doc: TLSOptions selects the built-in TLS mode.

nodes.name: certReloader
nodes.doc: certReloader serves a certificate from PEM files and re-reads them when the files change (checked at most every checkEvery on a handshake) or when Reload is called, for example on SIGHUP.

nodes.name: migration
nodes.doc: migration is one schema step.

nodes.name: tlsSetup
nodes.doc: tlsSetup holds what Run needs for the chosen TLS mode.
